Opposite Party Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rajesh Shankar For the
Petitioners : Mr. Rajendra Prasad Gupta, Advocate For the State : Mr. Shree Prakash Jha, A.P.P.
Order No. 04 Dated: 12.07.2024

The petitioners apprehending their arrest for the offences
punishable under Sections 376(2)(i) and 376(D) of the Indian Penal Code and Section 6 of Pocso
Act, have prayed for grant of anticipatory bail.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners have been falsely implicated in the present case and have not committed any offence as alleged.
The petitioners have not been named in the F.I.R and their name surfaced during investigation.

Subsequently, after investigation,
the police submitted final form in favour of various persons including the petitioners having found no evidence against them.

Thereafter, on an application preferred by the informant - Dukhni Bhakat under Section 319 of Cr.P.C, learned trial court issued summons to 22 such persons including the petitioners to face the trial.
The petitioners challenged the said order passed by learned trial court by filing Cr.M.P. No. 2003 of 2021 before this Court which was disposed of on 21.08.2023.
Under the said circumstance, the petitioners apprehend that if they appear before the trial court, they will be taken into judicial custody.

Learned counsel for the petitioners further submits that similarly situated co-accused namely, Brij Mohan Gupta @ Guddu Gupta, Amit Kumar Singh, Manoj Sahay &
Gurpreet Singh as well as Dinesh Agarwal, Imdad Ansari and Tanusri Sardar @ Tanushree Nayak have already been granted anticipatory bail by different Benches of this Court vide orders dated 08.04.2024, 15.05.2024, 15.05.2024, 14.06.2024 & 14.06.2024 passed in A.B.A No. 774/2024,
A.B.A No. 2380/2024, A.B.A No. 2381/2024, A.B.A No. 2243/2024 & A.B.A No. 8565/2023 respectively whereas co-accused Munna Dhobi @ Sonu Kumar Rajak and Sony Nayyar @ Nishant Kumar Nayyar have been granted anticipatory bail by this Court vide orders dated 08.07.2024 and 09.07.2024 passed in A.B.A. No. 3225 of 2024 and A.B.A. No. 3375 of 2024 respectively.
The petitioners undertake to co-operate in the ongoing investigation.
Hence, they may be given the privilege of anticipatory bail.
3. Learned A.P.P. opposes the petitioners' prayer for anticipatory bail.

4. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and considering that similarly situated co-accused persons have already been granted anticipatory bail by this Court, I am inclined to enlarge the petitioners on anticipatory bail.

5. Accordingly, the petitioners above named, in the event of their arrest/surrender within three weeks from today, shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.20,000/- (Rupees Twenty thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Additional Sessions Judge-V-cum-Special Judge (POCSO), Jamshedpur in connection with Mango P.S. Case No. 13/2018, corresponding to Special POCSO Case No. 174 of 2018, subject to the condition as laid down under Section 438(2) Cr.P.C.
Ritesh/ (Rajesh Shankar, J.)
